title: What is Alexandria, in plain English
summary: Alexandria makes the Firecrawl you already use better by getting data straight from official sources. Here's the short version.
body_markdown:
Most people know Firecrawl as the way their agent scrapes the web. It still is. Alexandria makes it better: when an official source has the answer, Firecrawl gets it from the source instead.


**Already using the Firecrawl plugin or MCP? You already have Alexandria.** The plugin and MCP are how you get it, with nothing new to install.


Alexandria covers hundreds of official sources: SEC filings, court opinions, research papers, company records, property data and more. When one of them fits, your agent gets structured records with a link to the original. When none does, Firecrawl scrapes the web as usual.


## Why we built it


Agents kept asking about things that already exist in official form. Reading a company's filings beats scraping a page about them. But each source has its own account, pricing and format, so we did the integrations once, inside Firecrawl. You use the key you already have and pay per use.


## What it costs


Finding and checking tools is free. Running one costs the credits listed on it. Our Government Index (about 30 million US government pages) and Research Index (40M+ paper abstracts) are free to use.


## Learn more


The full explainer covers what's in it, how it works and who gets paid:[What is Alexandria?](https://alexandria.firecrawl.dev/what-is-alexandria) . Or just[browse the library](https://alexandria.firecrawl.dev/) .
